verdict.rationale: Vendor pages only market feature outputs (summaries, action items, integrations) and generic claims like 'AI-powered meeting summaries' or 'live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition' — none disclose the transcription models used, accuracy benchmarks, or documented known limitations (e.g., accent/noise handling). Community comments (otter-comm-9) even note real accuracy gaps with accents that the vendor docs never acknowledge, reinforcing the absence of technical/quality documentation from Otter itself.
